notes: Files, Usage & Billing, Help and Profile now open inside the app, and Files takes drag-and-drop uploads. You stay signed in after the app sits idle, and a network blip no longer signs you out. If transcription stops mid-call you can retry it or end the session. The copilot remembers your earlier questions for follow-ups, a stalled answer no longer locks the composer, and untitled sessions are named from their summary.
